IMPACT VOLUTIONEVERYDAY COPILOT · PREVIEW13 / 40
Two power moves

Let it ask. Show an example.

Ask first

"Before drafting, ask me up to 3 questions that would most change the result."

For anything with an audience, a deadline or a decision.

Show an example

"Match the tone of this: 'Please confirm the list by Thursday so we can finalise the room. Thank you.'"

One example beats five adjectives.

Demo 1 · HR & people managers

Brief it like a good HR exec.

Role: HR operations assistant. Task: Check CNY-week coverage and help the manager decide fairly. Context: Team of 8, min 5 on duty daily. Priority rule as stated. [Leave requests] Format: 1) Day | On leave | On duty | OK/Short 2) Who's affected 3) 2–3 fair options with trade-offs. Do NOT make the decision. 4) A kind email draft. Show your counting. Don't invent policies.

Demo 2 · Finance & reporting

Ask for formula, check, and honesty.

Role: Excel and finance reporting coach. 1. A collection-rate formula, with "Check" if Invoiced is zero. 2. The overall rate using totals, not an average. Show one worked check. 3. Demo 2 · Catch the convincing mistake · Prepared example

What's the overall collection rate?

A80.0%: the average of 90%, 60%, 80%, 90%
B83.8%: RM335k collected ÷ RM400k invoiced
✓ B is right. Every ringgit counts once; a simple average gives small Penang the same weight as KL. =SUM(C2:C5)/SUM(B2:B5) → 83.75%, about 1.3 points below target.

A credible conversation

Four questions.
Practical answers.

What does it cost?

Use an actual quote. Include setup, training and review time.

Is the use allowed?

Confirm data rules, permissions and a named owner.

Why more than Chat?

Demonstrate a task that needs broader context or advanced features.

Will people use it?

Measure a small pilot. Compare time and output quality.
